sloka: याचितौ प्रशमम् तत्र जग्मतुः तौ सुर उत्तमौ ।जृम्भितम् तत् धनुः दृष्ट्वा शैवम् विष्णु पराक्रमैः ॥१-७५-१९॥
transliteration: yācitau praśamam tatra jagmatuḥ tau sura uttamau ।jṛmbhitam tat dhanuḥ dṛṣṭvā śaivam viṣṇu parākramaiḥ ॥1-75-19॥

translations.english: Now that the bow of Siva was made inert by Visnu's prowess, hosts of sages and gods acknowlged Visnu as superior.
